name: Sculptor
quote: It presents the Sculptor cluster as a super-cluster of the globular type and of galactic dimensions; or a symmetrical Magellanic Cloud devoid of its characteristic bright stars, clusters, and luminous diffuse nebulosity; or a nearby spheroidal galaxy, highly resolved, and of abnormally low surface brightness. These phrases are merely different ways of describing the same thing and of pointing out the uniqueness of the object. We may have here a transition type of stellar system.

name: Sextans
quote: A new Sculptor-type dwarf elliptical galaxy at a distance of 85 kpc has been found in the constellation of Sextans. ... Photographic B_J, R colour-magnitude diagrams reveal a pronounced 'red' horizontal branch and a well-defined asymptotic giant branch typical of dwarf spheroidal systems.

name: Carina
quote: The object is completely resolved into stars and has all the attributes of a dwarf elliptical galaxy of the type often known as dwarf spheroidal ...: namely very low surface brightness, a low degree of central concentration, and marked symmetry and uniformity with no evidence of gas or dust. Its large angular extent ... make it much too large and distant to be a star cluster.
